name: Bone Cleaver (Phách Cốt Phủ)

arts.name: Bone-Splitting Chop (Phách Cốt Trảm)
arts.rule: A slow heavy chop with a butcher's axe. Each chop writes 1 Debt and hardens a little body shield, feeding the Unbroken Flesh arts.

lore: A slaughterhouse axe that outer-court body cultivators are handed to learn the weight of a blow.
build_use: The Iron Body's first weapon: a slow chop that starts the Debt and shield the Unbroken Flesh arts later spend.

name: Ring of Tempered Marrow (Luyện Tủy Giới)
lore: A ring of boiled-bone lacquer that body cultivators wear from their first day of tempering.
build_use: Any thể tu's early ring: more health, faster regrowth, a little block while the body shield is not yet built.

name: Mountain-Hide Armour (Sơn Bì Giáp)

wards.name: Mountain-Hide Shell (Sơn Bì Xác)
wards.notes: The starter shell at 1.4 times its payload and its cast cost, so the price check is unchanged (4.711 of 4.766)

lore: Layered ox and boar hide, stitched with iron wire, taken from the sparring grounds of a body-tempering sect.
build_use: The Iron Body against sword and fist cultivators: a bigger Physical ward over a thick health pool.

name: Mountain-Gate Shield (Sơn Môn Thuẫn)

wards.name: Mountain-Gate Ward (Sơn Môn Chướng)
wards.notes: The starter shield at 2 times its shield and its cast cost, so the price check is unchanged (3.750 of 3.813)

lore: A door-sized slab of black stone slung on a strap, carried by the gate wardens of a body-tempering sect.
build_use: Bulwark builds: a large cast shield that sits beside the body shield, with block for the small hits.

name: Stone-Marrow Pendant (Thạch Tủy Bội)

reserve_arts.name: Stone-Marrow Aura (Thạch Tủy Quang)
reserve_arts.rule: While reserved, your body shields are 10 % stronger and you gain 10 block.
reserve_arts.notes: Priced by Formulas I reserve arts: 10 % reserved buys up to 10 W (9.1 W granted)

lore: A jade pebble ground from the marrow of a mountain spirit's bone; it is cold and heavy as a fist.
build_use: The Iron Body's sustain: leech and regrowth that keep the body shield up, and a standing shield bonus paid in linh lực.

name: Seal of Unbroken Flesh (Bất Hoại Nhục Ấn)

arts.name: Flesh-Seal Slam (Nhục Ấn Áp)
arts.rule: Counts as an Unbroken Flesh Canon art. A heavy seal slam that writes 2 Debt and hardens a body shield worth 5 % of your health. With 4 Debt and a body shield of 20 % of your health held, the seal presses down as the Flesh Seal: 3.5 times as hard, spending the Debt.

lore: A basalt seal pressed into the flesh of each disciple of the Unbroken Flesh lineage, so their canon answers to it.
build_use: Unbroken Flesh Canon builds: a fourth canon art that feeds the three-arts-in-2-s route and writes Debt for Marrow Tithe and Last Breath Fist.

name: Ring of Renewed Iron Skin (Thiết Bì Phục Giới)
lore: A ring of black iron that tightens with every blow its wearer throws.
build_use: Bulwark and Mountain Root builds: every Physical art refills the body shield, so the shield the Bulwark Knuckle hits with never stays down.

name: Echo-Skin Drum (Hưởng Bì Cổ)
lore: A hand drum stretched with the hide of an echo ape; each strike on it is answered a heartbeat later.
build_use: Hundred Echo Palm Scripture builds: faster, crit-heavy fists and palms, and Echo repeats a landed art for free.

name: Vajra-Hide Armour (Kim Cương Bì Giáp)

effects.name: Shield Pays the Blood (Thuẫn Thế Huyết)
effects.rule: Health that your arts would cost is paid from your body shield first, point for point; once the shield is gone, health pays again.
effects.reads: Your arts' health costs and your body shield, live
effects.payload: Health costs paid by body shield
effects.from: new (Marrow Tithe Strike's health cost, paid in shield instead of flesh)
effects.status: in effects.md (approved by the user 2026-11-13; accepted 2026-11-12)

wards.name: Vajra Shell (Kim Cương Xác)
wards.notes: The starter shell at 2 times its payload and its cast cost, so the price check is unchanged (4.711 of 4.766)

holder: An elder of a body-tempering sect at Core Formation or above; otherwise Lost beneath a collapsed mountain gate
lore: A suit grown, not forged: a thể tu's own hide, shed at his ascension and hardened for a thousand years.
build_use: Marrow Tithe builds: the tithe is paid by the body shield, so health stays full while the Debt piles up for the x11 Last Marrow.

name: Mountain-Splitting Axe (Phích Sơn Phủ)

arts.name: Splitting the Mountain (Phích Sơn)
arts.rule: A slow axe blow that deals 5 % more for every 5 % of health held as body shield, and winds 1 Debt for each hit you take (once a pulse). With 5 Debt, and either Mountain Root held or a body shield of 30 % of your health, the axe splits the mountain: 4.5 times as hard, spending the Debt.

holder: A Nascent Soul thể tu who has held it since the last sect war; otherwise the final reward of a Legendary quest in a body sect's ruins
lore: The axe that cut a peak in two to open a sect's gate; its edge is still the width of the gap.
build_use: The Mountain Root Bulwark: stand in the stance, take the hits, and the axe turns Debt and shield into one blow while its leech keeps the body full.

name: Iron-Gate Armour (Thiết Môn Giáp)

wards.name: Iron-Gate Ward (Thiết Môn Chướng)
wards.notes: The starter ward at 1.5 times its payload and its drain, so the price check is unchanged (3.049 of 3.050)

lore: Plates riveted from a sect gate's iron bands; the gate warden's own qi leaks into them and never stops.
build_use: A standing drain ward above the starter for body-and-Earth walls, with a body shield and regrowth under it.
notes: Answers: deity-warden: a ward that pays and drains; starter-wall: an armour ward above the starter drain ward; ninth-bell: a family-neutral ward that beats the build's own. Plain modifiers 36.6 W of 38.3 W.

name: Ring of the Answering Stone (Ứng Thạch Giới)

effects.name: Stone Answers (Thạch Ứng)
effects.rule: When your body shield or a ward stops damage, you strike back with a free Physical hit worth 25 % of the damage stopped, at most 6 % of your maximum health per pulse.
effects.reads: Damage stopped by your shields and wards, live
effects.payload: A free Physical hit (Return channel), capped per pulse
effects.closes: None (a trigger; the cap per pulse is its limit)
effects.from: new (mirror-hide: a Return-channel Effect for body gear)
effects.status: in effects.md (approved by the user 2026-11-13; accepted 2026-11-12, patch 2026-11-13)

lore: A ring cut from a gate-stone that rang back every ram thrown at it.
build_use: Mirror Hide and Debt of Stone builds: what the shield stops comes back as a free Physical hit.
notes: Answers: mirror-hide: a Return-channel Effect, ring or armour. Plain modifiers 34.6 W of 38.3 W.

name: Pledge Anchor (Thệ Cốt Mao)

arts.name: Pledge Drop (Thệ Cốt Trầm)
arts.rule: Counts as an Unbroken Flesh Canon art. An anchor dropped on a pledge of 6 % of your health: it writes 3 Debt and hardens a little body shield without taking a single hit. With 4 Debt the pledge is called in: 3 times as hard, spending the Debt.

lore: A ship's anchor that body cultivators swear oaths on, paying a measure of blood at each drop.
build_use: Debt of Stone and Last Marrow builds: a health-paid art that writes Debt without hits and is a fifth canon art.
notes: Answers: mirror-hide: a health-payment art; unique-mountain-splitting-axe: a Debt source that needs no hits; unique-vajra-hide-armour: a Debt-reading canon art. Plain modifiers 36.2 W of 38.3 W.

name: Pendant of the First Stand (Tiên Lập Bội)

effects.name: First Stand (Tiên Lập)
effects.rule: At the start of a fight, your body shield is already raised to 30 % of your maximum health.
effects.payload: Body shield set to 30 % of health at t = 0
effects.closes: None (once, at the start; it does not refill)
effects.from: new (unique-mountain-splitting-axe: shield held at 30 % without the stance)
effects.status: in effects.md (approved by the user 2026-11-13; accepted 2026-11-12, patch 2026-11-13)

lore: A pendant of gate-stone worn by wardens who meet the first blow already hardened.
build_use: Mountain-Splitting Axe and Bulwark builds: the 30 % body shield gate is open from the first pulse.
notes: Answers: unique-mountain-splitting-axe: a body shield held at 30 % at fight start. Plain modifiers 24.0 W of 25.6 W.
